youtube.title: NASA Engineers Begged for Photos of Columbia's Wing. Managers Said No.
youtube.description:
82 seconds after Columbia's launch on 16 January 2003, foam struck its left wing. Engineers asked three times for satellite images of the damage; the requests went nowhere. On 1 February, Columbia broke apart over Texas, 16 minutes before landing. A later test showed the foam could punch a 16-inch hole in the wing.

📂 Case File #041: The Columbia Warning

Sources: UPI, "NASA e-mail shows shuttle safety questioned" (2003), https://www.upi.com/Science_News/2003/04/01/NASA-e-mail-show-shuttle-safety-questioned/67911049210136/ ; Columbia Accident Investigation Board report (2003), via Wikipedia summary and citations.
